name: İyi Finans
verdict: The savings-finance (tasarruf finansmanı) brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş.
note: Rating note: Iyi Finans became the Turkiye Ligi-only below-back-number sponsor of Fenerbahce Tarfin in September 2026 (club announcement, 2026-09-18). It is the brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.S., a BDDK-licensed savings-finance company founded 2025; press interviews name chairman Ekrem Yuksel. ON HOLD: proposed 'none' - the ownership claim needs a second, independent source (the club announcement and the company's own federation news do not establish who owns the company).
